listing.name: Killzone — KillzoneRecomp-Extended (Tzeentchnet)
listing.summary: Upstream reports startup, movies, profile selection, first-mission gameplay, Quit/Continue/load, and timing/input checks. Later 14/14 checks without an ISO test the harness rather than campaign completion. Intermittently cut-off combat effects and dialogue remain tracked as AUDIO-01. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own NTSC-U Killzone SCUS-97402 ISO. Local code generation also requires the extracted SCUS_974.02 ELF. The exact accepted ISO/ELF hash and revision are unknown here; check upstream before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the Windows source-build instructions to install the locked dependencies, generate code from your own ELF, build the runtime and package a player folder. The README calls this a test build; public ready-built release availability is not confirmed.

warnings: Upstream reports startup, movies, profile selection, first-mission gameplay, Quit/Continue/load, and timing/input checks. Later 14/14 checks without an ISO test the harness rather than campaign completion. Intermittently cut-off combat effects and dialogue remain tracked as AUDIO-01.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
